routes.name: Baba Yaga
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Yeti'. Take the leftmost line in the wall. All titanium bolts. Named after the mythical character (witch) in the Slavic folklore.
routes.setter: Mike W, Stanislav Dzen, Leif Backstrom & friends

routes.name: Yeti
routes.desc: Great crimpy sustained climbing. Shares the start with 'Baba Yaga'. Try to stay as direct as possible on the 4th to last bolt. Don't be confused by the line of bolts to the right on the big ledge, there is an old variation of 'Black Mamba', which nowadays has its own start.

routes.name: Black Mamba
routes.desc: Start on the left of 'Yak', on the left side of the big tufa.

routes.name: Banshee
routes.desc: Tufa fun for the first half, then steep and long to the very top of the karst. Named after the Thai mythical character. _70m rope is a minimum. Tie a knot on the end!_

routes.name: Shrek
routes.desc: 8 slings, anchor before the roof.

routes.name: Dragon
routes.desc: Fun, steep moves on good holds, an epic juggy roof, then a mix of powerful moves and technical face climbing to the anchor. When getting out the roof, there is a long blue sling with a biner hanging from a bolt. You should clip in the biner, but it is not recommended to then clip a quickdraw on that same bolt, as it adds a lot of drag.

routes.name: Terminator
routes.desc: Same start as 'Dragon', then right into the big roof.

routes.name: Herminator
routes.desc: Start up 'Hercules', head left through the roof and link into the 'Terminator' finish.

routes.name: Baby Hercules
routes.desc: Same start as 'Hulk', then head left at the 2nd clip. _Watch loose rock! Tell people on the ground to watch out!_

routes.name: Hercules
routes.desc: Extension of 'Baby Hercules', 3 clips through the horizontal roof.

routes.name: Bruce Banner
routes.desc: Endurance climbing which comes up to first anchor on 'Hulk'. Fixed draws.

routes.name: Hulk
routes.desc: Climbs 'Bruce Banner', then do the "transformation into the Hulk"! Super good climbing! Climb direct! It is tempting to go right to the jugs of King Kong, skipping the hard moves and the start of the crux. Only 7b then and you are missing out on a glorious crimpy sequence to test yourself.

routes.name: Son of Rambo
routes.desc: Start on the black tufa pedestal. _Watch out after the first clip! Potential of hitting the rock below on a lead fall._

routes.name: Rambo
routes.desc: Extension of 'Son of Rambo'. Alternatively, start from 'King Kong' and link, going right at the cave.

routes.name: The Joker
routes.desc: Why so serious? Let's put a smile on that face.

routes.name: Thor
routes.desc: Start up the ladder, then head left. Excellent climbing.

routes.name: Godzilla
routes.desc: _Use a 70m Rope and tie a knot or use the midway anchor to lower down._

routes.name: Jaws
routes.desc: Dynamic moves. Great climbing.

routes.name: Thunder
routes.desc: Nice moves.

routes.name: Thunder Extension
routes.desc: Extension of 'Thunder', heading up the tufa.

routes.name: Lightning
routes.desc: Pumpy overhang, really fun.

routes.name: Lightning Extension
routes.desc: Extension of 'Lightning', up the chimney.

routes.name: Where's Jordan?
routes.desc: To the left of the tree. To the left of the route 'Hello Welcome', sharing anchor with 'Hello Welcome'.

routes.name: Hello Welcome
routes.desc: Currently second route from the left, just right of the tree. (Note: the tree may be removed, and more routes may be developed to the left of this route.) Shared anchor with 'Where's Jordan?'

routes.name: Mr Dean
routes.desc: Currently the third of the five routes (this may change as more routes may be developed).

routes.name: Everybody Loves Lek
routes.desc: Currently the forth route (counting from left to right; this may change if more routes get developed at this sector).

routes.name: Kiera
routes.desc: Currently the most right hand route (this may change if more routes get developed in this sector)

routes.name: BAO
routes.desc: Start on a big jug under the cave, then continues straight up vertically. Use a clipstick for pre-clipping the first bolt.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: King's Landing
routes.desc: Starts just right of the small cave. Beautiful climbing at 6b+/c level up to short but intense bouldery crux on the final overhang.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Dragon Glass
routes.desc: Linkup. Starts on 'King's Landing' and finishes on the anchor of 'White Walker'. Traverse right at the last sling before the final overhang.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: White Walker
routes.desc: Starts just right of 'King's Landing'. Short crux, then easier.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Mr Ya
routes.desc: Starts left of the tufa.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Santa Sends
routes.desc: Sustained and consistent with a couple of small cruxes. 'Santa Sends' and 'Dr Desire' were the first two routes at North Wall.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Dr Desire
routes.desc: _60m rope is minimum. Tie a knot at the end of the rope._
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Slippery When Wet
routes.desc: Tufa is slippery when wet - hence the route name. 1 bolt, 9 slings.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Backscratcher
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Honey Hunter
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Find a Heart
routes.desc: 4 bolts, 9 slings.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Crazy Amounts of Pleasure
routes.desc: Tricky first bulge. Then straight up to the anchor below the roof. 4 bolts, 6 slings.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Gravity
routes.desc: Warning Fixed Gear: Do not top rope from the ring at the anchor
warnings: Fixed Gear: Do not top rope from the ring at the anchor
Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Diana Ross
routes.desc: Follow the fixed red draws to go straight up. Once climbed over the ledge, turn right for one more clip. The anchor is right around the corner. Fixed draws all the way - only one QD required for the first sling.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Gladiator
routes.desc: Climb 'Diana Ross' to the ledge and then left into the horizontal roof for 'Gladiator' finish. Shares anchor with 'Diana Ross Extension'. Has fixed draws.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Diana Ross Extension
routes.desc: From the 'Diana Ross' anchor, climb through the roof using fixed draws. Shares anchor with 'Gladiator'.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Blood Moon
routes.desc: Short crux in the roof. Start and finish easier. 5 titanium bolts, 5 slings.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: New Moon
routes.desc: Shares same start as 'Blood Moon' then climb right through roof/crack.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Full Moon
routes.desc: Same start as 'Blood Moon'. After the overhang section, climb left through the small roof.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: The Stoneman
routes.desc: Warning Fixed Gear: Top anchor rope super shredded Starts in the corner. Finishes at the anchor left of 'Carrie On'.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Top anchor rope super shredded
Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Carrie On
routes.desc: Starts on the tufa. Finishes on the anchor to the right of 'The Stoneman'.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Queen of the Highway
routes.desc: Starts up the ladder, left of 'Lizard King'. Cruxy dihedral right at the start, then easier. 4 bolts, 13 slings.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Lizard King
routes.desc: Starts up the ladder, right of 'Queen of the Highway'. 5 bolts, 6 slings.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Tufantastic
routes.desc: Adventurous route that goes round the tufa system. Starts to the right of 'the Stoneman', finishes to the right of 'Lizard King'. To avoid rope drag the lead climber should unclip bolt 1 after clipping bolt 2, and unclip bolt 2 after clipping bolt 3\. To make it safe for the toprope climber, these need to be clipped back in with a stickclip.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Update: Hornet situation as of 9.3.2026

routes.name: Pinball Wizard
routes.desc: Left of 'Natalie'. Appears to have a two sling extension. All slings.

routes.name: Natalie
routes.desc: Obvious line behind tufa curtains. Crux is getting to the anchor through the final chimney. There are two easier second pitches which continue on from the top of this route. Maybe bring a bottle of water and do all three. The belay station for the second pitches is comfortable and protected from the rain.

routes.name: Luke
routes.desc: Starts at the anchor of 'Natalie' and goes left. Shares the anchor with 'Rosie'. 3 bolts, 7 slings. There is a big cave at the top of this route, 40m above the ground, it has a nice view and is a good place to hang out.

routes.name: Rosie
routes.desc: Starts at the anchor of 'Natalie' and goes right, sharing anchors with its left neighbor 'Luke'. A bit harder than 'Luke'.

routes.name: Tufa Love
routes.desc: Climb up and right, following blue slings, to the anchor on the right below the roof. _Top rope is highly recommended for draws cleaning._

routes.name: Tufa Love Extension
routes.desc: Three-sling extension. Climbs leftwards through the overhang.

routes.name: Kung Fu Panda / Kung Fu KK
routes.desc: Shares the first bolt with 'The Fortress', then climb left. Big jugs and awesome moves up the gentle overhang, followed by 3D tufa fun! FA: Marcela, 20 Nov 2023

routes.name: The Fortress
routes.desc: Shares the first bolt with 'Kung Fu Panda', then climb up and right to ledge. Be ready to climb in all directions on your 3D tufa journey! Up, left, right, and down. At first gap step over, once your standing, take your time to flick/swing rope under (elephant-foot) tuffa to stop rope drag. Fixed draws all the way. Titanium bolts + new slings added May 2026. Maint: Dave Hood, 12 May
routes.setter: Dave Hood, Daling Rivera & Lucho birkner

routes.name: Blue Crush
routes.desc: Short and sweet!

routes.name: Lime Crush
routes.desc: Short and spicy! 5 green slings through the bulging roof. Top out to standing on the ledge.

routes.name: Cyber Punks
routes.desc: Pumpy and super fun! Reminds a bit of 'Tidal Wave'. Fixed red draws.

routes.name: MACD
routes.desc: Long and fun!

routes.name: HODL / Hold on for Dear Life
routes.desc: Tufa fun!

routes.name: Captain Tripp
routes.desc: 1 6a18m 2 5c12m 3 6a22m The perfect beginner multipitch, friendly and fun! All titanium bolts. 1. Climb up the ladder, move left and up the corner to the ledge. 4 slings, 5 bolts. 2. Traverse left horizontally, along the 3D tufa ledge, to the anchor around corner. Can be combined with P1 into one mega pitch. 7 slings. 3. Climb straight up the slab/corner and finish in a glorious cave room. 7 slings, 4 bolts. Rappel A 70m rope just reaches the ground from the top of P3\. If using a 60m rope, stop at the midway anchor. _Tie a knot in the end of your rope!_

routes.name: Dylan the Dog
routes.desc: Up the ladder, into the slabby dihedral, then the left across the tufas towards a steep pumpy finish. Be careful with brittle rock! 9 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Covid-19
routes.desc: Awesome, fun, pumpy! 3 bolts, 8 slings. Watch out for small breaky holds. Still needs some traffic. Note December 2025: The local laminated topo at the crag incorrectly labels this route as a 7a.
routes.setter: Dave Hood, Daling Rivera, Leif Backstrom & Jai

routes.name: Omnicron-22
routes.desc: Stay left at the crux for 7b. Don't go right into 'Life of Leif'.

routes.name: Life of Leif
routes.desc: 1 6a17m 2 6b+11m Climb as one pitch. 11 bolts, 6 slings.

routes.name: Dogs Run Free
routes.desc: On the right side of 'Life of Leif'. 9 bolts, 4 slings.

routes.name: Sushi
routes.desc: Everybody likes Sushi! Shares anchors with 'Wasabi'. 1 bolt, 4 slings.

routes.name: Wasabi
routes.desc: Shares anchors with 'Sushi'.

routes.name: Sexual Climber
routes.desc: 5m extension to either 'Sushi' or 'Wasabi'. After the last bolt of 'Wasabi', head up right to the anchors of 'Air Jordan'.

routes.name: Dazed and Confused
routes.desc: Start on top of pedestal. After vertical crack traverse right stepping across gap and continue right and up the tufa systems.

routes.name: Red Lining / Red Lining.to the Max
routes.desc: Same start as 'Dazed and Confused', then head left into the openbook corner. Continue left up the face with the thin tufa to the anchor.

routes.name: Dazed Lining
routes.desc: Same start as 'Red Lining', then head left into the openbook corner and continue right up the face with the big tufa to the anchor of 'Dazed and Confused'. Grade needs to be settled. Please mark your grade (6c or 6c+) when logging ascents.

routes.name: Air Jordan
routes.desc: Same start as 'Red Lining'/'Dazed and Confused', then left via crazy Superman-dyno to the big hole. Shares anchors with 'Sexual Climber'. 8 bolts, 2 slings. Grade needs confirmation, please try!

routes.name: Motor City Madhouse
routes.desc: Up the ladder. Gives access to the following routes, all starting from the Rock'n Roll ledge.

routes.name: Vagabonds of the Western World
routes.desc: Left route starting from the left belay anchor on the Rock'n Roll ledge. Access via 'Motor City Madhouse'.

routes.name: Tangled up in Blue
routes.desc: Warning Flora and Fauna: Hornets Right route starting from the left belay anchor on the Rock'n Roll ledge. Access via 'Motor City Madhouse'.

routes.name: Shotgun Blues
routes.desc: Leftmost route on the right side of the Rock'n Roll ledge. Access via 'Motor City Madhouse' and traversing right along the fixed rope.

routes.name: Creep
routes.desc: Middle line starting from the right belay anchor on the Rock'n Roll ledge. Access via 'Motor City Madhouse' and traversing right along the fixed rope.

routes.name: Master of Puppets
routes.desc: Right line starting from the right belay anchor on the Rock'n Roll ledge. Access via 'Motor City Madhouse' and traversing right along the fixed rope. Climb up and right of the huge stalactite above the belay.

routes.name: Lady Rose
routes.desc: Warning Fixed Gear: Two slings need replacing First climb to left of 'Can I Play with Madness'. Climb past 3 bolts, step over the ledge, clipping slings, and traverse around/out onto the bulging face and arête to finish.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Two slings need replacing

routes.name: Can I Play with Madness
routes.desc: The straight line to the right anchor on the Rock'n Roll ledge, up the white face. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Mad Max
routes.desc: Shares the first jug-hold on 'Can I Play with Madness', then immediately head right and up the face towards the tufa. (No sidewall bridging to right).

routes.name: Furiosa
routes.desc: Four-bolt extension to 'Mad Max'. Open project. Please try!

routes.name: Keep Yourself Alive
routes.desc: Must-do climb! Climbs the obvious corner right of 'Mad Max'. Jugs and bridging, slightly polished footholds. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Simon's Tales
routes.desc: Start up the overhang and exit the lip with some bridging and straight up the arête. Shares anchors with 'Keep Yourself Alive'.

routes.name: Thunderstruck
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Heartbreaker', then left towards the cave after the 4th clip and up on the inside of the pillar. Rejoins with 'Heartbreaker' after the 10th clip. 9 bolts, 8 slings.

routes.name: Heartbreaker
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Thunderstruck'. Veers right after the 4th clip into the white tufa pipes. Rejoins with 'Thunderstruck' about halfway. 5 bolts, 12 slings.

routes.name: Spanish Caravan
routes.desc: Straight up the steep orange-white rock into the white tufa pipes. Joins up with 'The Passenger' about halfway. 6 bolts, 9 slings.

routes.name: The Passenger
routes.desc: Climbs up on orange tufas, 3m right of 'Spanish Caravan'. Then slightly left to join 'Spanish Caravan' on the ledge about halfway. 8 bolts, 10 slings.

routes.name: Psycho Killer
routes.desc: Easy sustained climbing all the way to the roof, a perfect warm up. It's the second to last route at the sector (starts left of 'The End'). At the anchor it's possible to continue into 'Freebird'. 9 bolts, 4 slings

routes.name: Freebird
routes.desc: Same start as 'The End' for 6 bolts, then go left.

routes.name: The End
routes.desc: About 5m right of 'The Passenger', on structured brown and white rock. Fun moves on crimps towards the anchor. Titanium bolts and slings.

routes.name: Krabi Bolt Fund
routes.desc: To the right of 'The End'. Has its own anchor.

routes.name: Rock & Sun
routes.desc: To the right of Krabi Bolt Fund. Has its own anchor.

routes.name: Mythical Traverse
routes.desc: From a low start below the route Lightning traverse the base of the wall up left to a drop off from good pockets just left of the route Jaws.

routes.name: Jurassic Traverse
routes.desc: Start from either a sit (6a+) or from a stand start (6a) at the edge of the small cave (Jurassic Cave) next to the leftmost route Kings Landing and traverse the base of the wall to the right to a no hands rest on a large foot blob. Traverse further right after the rest to add on another less difficult but fun section for full credit.

routes.name: Rock n Roll Traverse
routes.desc: Originally done from right to left starting from the far right side of Rock n Roll Wall. Traverse the base of the wall to the left to a no hands rest in an alcove. Good in either direction. Technical vertical face climbing.
